summary: cherenkov_angle.py computed the Cherenkov photon yield without the z^2 of the Frank-Tamm formula, so multiply charged species got the yield of z = 1.

database_specific.introduced_basis: the defective code is in the script as first released (hep-research 0.3.0, commit 351029c0)

observables: expected photon yield and per-track angular resolution of cherenkov_angle.py
impact.bias: the yield was low by a factor z^2 and sigma_theta high by z: He4 at 40 GeV/c, n = 1.05 gave 17.02 photons instead of 68.08 and sigma_theta 1.212 instead of 0.606 mrad; z = 1 unchanged
impact.trigger: a species with charge number z > 1 (He3, He4 or a mass:charge with charge above 1)

outputs.how_to_recognize: JSON on stdout with the Cherenkov angle, expected_photons, p_no_photon and photon_regime

remedy: rerun cherenkov_angle.py with a release that has the fix for any z > 1 species; a separation or ring-photon estimate built on the old yield is z^2 pessimistic
